family.selection_basis: The Markdown report and its explicitly named machine-readable companion form a two-leaf publication unit. This is the smallest non-singleton structurally declared companion family remaining in canonical META UNVERIFIED scope after excluding PR #204’s 26 historical leaves.

paths.semantic_scope: Complete-file review of the pinned qualified audit report as a dated, explicitly incomplete evidence presentation. family.disposition_basis: Each exact leaf received complete-file review at its pinned baseline blob. DIRECT is bounded to the report’s qualified, incomplete, source-pinned presentation semantics and explicit negative claims; references are not recursively adopted or independently re-proven.

grouped_equivalence.reason: The prose and JSON have different schemas and detail. Each leaf is proposed DIRECT after individual complete-file review; no interchangeable-payload or GROUPED claim is made.

review.method: Complete reading of both exact baseline blobs; strict parsing of the JSON companion; comparison of report identity, qualified opinion, five source coordinates/counts, 308 DIRECT / 113 GROUPED / 3940 UNVERIFIED accounting, 14 unresolved obligations, and explicit no-readiness/no-completion boundaries.
review.scope: The two reports as a source-pinned qualified audit presentation and machine-readable companion, not recursive review of referenced registers or present-state revalidation.
limitations: No provider source was written or executed, and no live provider/runtime/admin state was observed by this candidate.

Agreement checks cover identity, top-level disposition/accounting, source coordinates/counts, open-obligation count, and negative readiness/completion semantics; they are not proof that every narrative sentence mirrors every referenced register.

The reports are canonical accounting surfaces and remain byte-identical; this worker proposes coverage only and does not edit or adopt them.

adversarial_cases: Reject a missing, extra, duplicated, reordered, renamed, or blob/byte-drifted report leaf.
Reject GROUPED or any disposition other than per-leaf DIRECT.
Reject malformed or duplicate-key JSON and disagreement in bound report identity, source coordinates/counts, semantic accounting, obligation count, or negative readiness/completion fields.
Reject current/live truth, recursive-reference verification, readiness, completion, authority, adoption, or provider-write claims.
Reject standalone or sequential projection totals that do not isolate this +2 delta from PR #204’s still-unadopted +26 delta.
Reject any mutation outside the exact worker path allowlist, especially canonical accounting/report surfaces.

recheck_triggers: Either report path, byte content, Git blob identity, baseline tree, or source coordinate changes.
PR #185 advances in a way that changes either report or its canonical accounting/source assumptions before lead handoff or adoption.
